Game Overview

In Kly Kly, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a whimsical yet challenging journey in Kly Kly, where a mysterious blob in an explorer hat traverses perilous 2D platforming landscapes. Master quick jumps, wall climbs, and savvy enemy evasion to uncover secrets and conquer ingenious levels filled with traps, treasures, and relentless foes.
